caption: The drawing depicts a frontal view of a human head and face. The figure has medium to dark brown skin, short curly black hair, and pronounced features including large eyes, broad nose, and full lips colored in a deep reddish-brown hue. The shading on the face and neck is done in multiple tones of brown and black, providing depth and dimension to the features. The head is centered inside a rectangular border, which is itself inside a larger off-white area. The signature "Gordena Jackson" appears in the bottom right corner of the inner rectangle. There are no other objects or backgrounds depicted in the image.
title: Negro Minstrel
